title: Ram Prasad v. State of Uttar Pradesh
text: The petitioner, Ram Prasad, filed this writ petition under Article 226 of the Constitution of India seeking a writ of mandamus directing the State government to reinstate him in service and pay arrears of salary. The petitioner was dismissed from service without following the procedure prescribed under Article 311. The High Court exercising its extraordinary jurisdiction under Article 226 examines whether the fundamental rights of the petitioner under Article 21 have been violated. The dismissal order was passed without conducting a disciplinary inquiry, violating the principles of natural justice and the petitioner's fundamental rights. The court issues a writ of mandamus directing reinstatement. The State is directed to pay 50% back wages. The order of dismissal is quashed as it violates the guarantee of livelihood which is part of the fundamental right to life under Article 21 of the Constitution.
